messages:
maria: Quick sync needed 1we need a short launch playbook for the website: launch posts, benchmark narrative, webinar, inbound form routing. Must map CTAs to Hosted / Dedicated / Private. Ideas?

jake: I can draft hero + three CTA cards and the launch post cadence. Recommend a standalone benchmarks deep-dive plus short callouts on pages.

elsa: I'll extract infra metrics and give three public-friendly callouts (latency, throughput, security). Can also give a 1-line engineer quote.

ryan: Webinar: 30m (20 demo / 10 Q&A). Panel: Product (maria), Eng (elsa), Ops (ryan), Customer (invite Glint). Demo shows smart routing, fallbacks, and Dedicated onboarding.

maria: Messaging: single concise hero (mode-agnostic) + three action cards: Hosted 1Try API (free credits), Dedicated 1Reserve capacity, Private 1Contact sales for VPC/on-prem. Each card gets a one-line clarifier.

olivia: Inbound form: add hidden fields: deployment_mode, interest_tier, region so SDRs can auto-route. Example hidden JSON stored as string: {\"deployment_mode\":\"private\",\"interest\":\"enterprise\"}.

jake: Enums: deployment_mode=[hosted,dedicated,private]; interest=[eval,prod,enterprise]; region=[NA,EU,APAC].

elsa: Draft benchmark blurbs (placeholders): \"Hosted: ~85ms median token latency; Dedicated: reserved pools ~12k tokens/s sustained; Private: VPC + KMS/HSM for regulated workloads.\"

maria: Launch post sequence: 1) Teaser + webinar signup, 2) Benchmarks deep-dive, 3) Customer spotlight, 4) Webinar reminder, 5) Launch recap + how-to. Each post links to the correct CTA per mode.

ryan: I'll draft 6 panel Qs: routing policy examples, burst handling, fallback strategy, Dedicated onboarding steps, telemetry & SLAs, security for Private.

olivia: Form routing mapping: if deployment_mode==private -> team-enterprise@; dedicated -> dedicated-sales@; hosted -> trial-nurture-queue. I'll add to the form builder and pass validation.

maria: Deliverables: Jake = 3 launch posts + webinar landing copy by Tue; Elsa = benchmark numbers + 2 short eng quotes; Olivia = form fields + routing rules; Ryan = confirm customer panelist + curate Qs; Maria = hero/headlines + 2 short prompt examples per mode.

jake: I'll post first drafts to #copy-ops and link here. :thumbsup:

mkt-bot: Reminder: webinar slot reserved Thu 10am PT 1 calendar invite sent to panelists.
